commit_stroke_durable.what: pen-up of a 200-point stroke until it is written to the page database

open_page_2000_strokes.what: open a stored page with 2 000 strokes and build the geometry of every stroke

pdf_300_pages_first_page.what: parse a 300-page PDF, size its first page and read its text layer

pdf_first_page_shown.what: 300-page PDF: import its first page (the app shows it, then imports the rest)

pdf_import_300_pages.what: import a 300-page PDF into a notebook (store once, 300 pages, text layers)

shape_recognition.what: recognise a hand-drawn circle (300 points) on pen-up

tile_50k_strokes_p95.what: p95 time of one 512 px tile display list, geometry cached, 50 000-stroke canvas (zooms 4 … 0.05)

note: normalised = median_ms / calibration_ms; regenerate with --write-baseline on the CI runner type
